reference_sql:
WITH days AS (
  -- one row per day, 3 to 15 March 2025
  SELECT CAST(range AS DATE) AS day
  FROM range(DATE '2025-03-03', DATE '2025-03-16', INTERVAL 1 DAY)
), daily AS (
  -- one row per day the campaign had spend
  SELECT a.spend_date AS day, SUM(a.spend) AS spend_eur
  FROM ad_spend_daily a
  JOIN campaigns c ON c.campaign_id = a.campaign_id
  WHERE c.utm_campaign = 'nb_email_marketing_software_2025'
    AND a.spend_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-03-03' AND DATE '2025-03-15'
  GROUP BY a.spend_date
), filled AS (
  -- one row per day of the range
  SELECT d.day, COALESCE(s.spend_eur, 0) AS spend_eur
  FROM days d
  LEFT JOIN daily s ON s.day = d.day
), moving AS (
  -- one row per day, with the 7 days ending that day
  SELECT day, AVG(spend_eur) OVER (ORDER BY day ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS avg_7d_spend_eur
  FROM filled
)
SELECT day, ROUND(avg_7d_spend_eur, 2) AS avg_7d_spend_eur
FROM moving
WHERE day >= DATE '2025-03-09'

solver.query:
WITH days AS (
  SELECT CAST(d AS DATE) AS day FROM generate_series(DATE '2025-03-03', DATE '2025-03-15', INTERVAL 1 DAY) t(d)
), s AS (
  SELECT a.spend_date AS day, SUM(a.spend) AS spend
  FROM ad_spend_daily a
  JOIN campaigns cp ON cp.campaign_id = a.campaign_id
  WHERE cp.utm_campaign = 'nb_email_marketing_software_2025'
    AND a.spend_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-03-03' AND DATE '2025-03-15'
  GROUP BY a.spend_date
), w AS (
  SELECT d.day, AVG(COALESCE(s.spend, 0)) OVER (ORDER BY d.day ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS a
  FROM days d LEFT JOIN s ON s.day = d.day
)
SELECT day, ROUND(a, 2) AS avg_7d_spend_eur
FROM w
WHERE day >= DATE '2025-03-09'
